name: evidenceDetails
//: Police (owning agency), Forensics (author), Prosecution (case preparation), Court (judicial review). Four member orgs so that a MAJORITY-of-six endorsement can be satisfied entirely by collection members - Fabric refuses to send transient data to an org outside the distribution policy, so the endorser set and this membership must be sized against the CURRENT organisation count.

name: accessRequestQuery
//: The requester's natural-language question. The ledger holds only its SHA-256. Every organisation whose members may raise a request must be a member, because memberOnlyWrite refuses the transient write otherwise - the policy engine is written to answer an oversight request with a governed RBAC_NO_PERMISSION deny, which it can only do if the request can be raised at all. The AI organisation is included so the model's own peer receives the question directly.
